_readme: Template for a feature-video product description_puck. Replace every <PLACEHOLDER> and delete this _readme key before applying.

The first two blocks are NOT optional. Every Deskwell description opens with the whole-product clip full width, then the product's short_description. Do not ask the user whether they want it; do not offer it as an extra. Feature sections start at index 2.

The hero clip is the one whose originalName is the plain product name with no feature words after it - 'Academy Visitor Chair.mp4', 'Eclipse Plus III Deluxe Mesh Back.mp4'. Blank maxWidth = full width, padding 'none', title and body empty so no two-track row is built.
The intro TextBlock takes shp_products.short_description verbatim. No short description on the product = drop the TextBlock, do not invent copy.
textSide is where the TEXT goes: 'left' = text left / video right, 'right' = text right / video left, 'above' = text stacked over the video.

Feature sides alternate automatically, video on the RIGHT first: section 1 textSide 'left', section 2 'right', section 3 'left', and so on. The opening video sits outside the alternation and does not shift it.

Match clips to sections on originalName from the Media table and NOTHING else. Never download a video, never extract frames. Two clips equally likely, or none obviously right, means STOP AND ASK the user - quoting the candidate filenames - not go looking.
radius 16px and frame true match the product image stage, so the description looks like it belongs to the gallery above it.
No topOffset and no scrub length: nothing pins, so the sticky header and tab bar never overlap a section.
visibility strings: 'true' HIDES on that device. All 'false' here - one block serves desktop, tablet and mobile.
Repeat the feature block per feature, alternating textSide, and add any other blocks (Heading, SpecPanel) around them.
